decisive_items: diffuse, generalized hyperintensity of the supratentorial white matter on T2/FLAIR sequences
response.rationale: The combination of early falls, progressive rigid-akinetic syndrome, cognitive/psychiatric symptoms, and diffuse supratentorial white matter changes best fits PSP among the supplied candidates; other candidates lack key supportive features or have contradicting ones.

rejected.why: No asymmetric apraxia, alien limb, or cortical sensory loss; diffuse white matter changes are not typical of CBD.
No ventriculomegaly or incontinence; diffuse white matter hyperintensity without hydrocephalus argues against NPH.
No autonomic dysfunction or cerebellar ataxia; diffuse white matter changes are not characteristic of MSA.
